title: reuse the parsed word for CRC
change_description: The structural parser returns its existing raw word along with the frame, and the decoder computes CRC directly from that word. Unconditional parser equality and the standard encoder syndrome theorem preserve the complete decoder refinement, including malformed inputs, parity and spare bits. [Implementation and proof evidence](../docs/GEN22-PARSED-WORD-CRC.md).
row_note: Proved parsed-word CRC reuse; full fixed/fresh 10M validation; clean fresh build; CPU 0; 3+21 ABAB
review_threshold: Both decode and CPR must independently reach 2/1; exact integer comparisons of measured medians; stop for user review only when both hold.
note: Prepared after completed fixed/fresh/native validation and before timing. Contains no speculative measurement. The unchanged reviewed reporting helper archives only completed measurements.
